title: DataService
description: A service for providing data at a URL or URLs

contactPoint.title: contact point
contactPoint.description: Contact information that can be used for sending comments about the Data Service

endpointDescription.title: endpoint description
endpointDescription.description: A list of descriptions of the services available via the end-points, including their operations, parameters etc

anyOf.description: An in-line description of the endpoint description

anyOf.title: Link
anyOf.description: reference iri of the endpoint description

endpointURL.title: endpoint URL
endpointURL.description: A list of root locations or primary endpoints of the service (a Web-resolvable IRI)

items.title: URLs
items.description: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (a Web-resolvable IRI)

keyword.title: keyword/tag
keyword.description: List of keywords or tags describing the Data Service

servesDataset.title: serves dataset
servesDataset.description: List of datasets that are served by this data service

spatialResolutionInMeters.title: spatial resolution in meters
spatialResolutionInMeters.description: The minimum spatial separation resolvable in a Data Service, measured in meters

temporalResolution.title: temporal resolution
temporalResolution.description: The minimum time period resolvable by the Data Service

theme.title: theme/category
theme.description: A list of themes of the Data Service. A Data Service may be associated with multiple themes

accessRights.title: access rights
accessRights.description: Information that indicates whether the Data Service is open data, has access restrictions or is public

anyOf.description: Text description of the access rights

anyOf.title: Link
anyOf.description: reference iri of the access rights

conformsTo.title: conforms to
conformsTo.description: List of general standards or specifications that the Data Service endpoints implement

created.title: creation date
created.description: The date on which the Data Service was first created

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

creator.title: creator
creator.description: List of agents primarily responsible for producing the Data Service

description.title: description
description.description: A free-text account of the Data Service

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for the Data Service, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the Catalog

otherIdentifier.title: other identifier
otherIdentifier.description: A list of identifiers for the Data Service besides the main identifier, e.g. the URI or other unique identifiers in the context of the Catalog

language.title: language
language.description: Language or languages supported by the Data Service. This should be provided as an ISO 639-1 language code, which can be seen at https://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/iso639-1.html

license.title: license
license.description: The license under which the Data Service is made available; see https://resources.data.gov/schemas/dcat-us/open-licenses for more information regarding license-free declarations and licenses

modified.title: update/modification date
modified.description: The most recent date on which the Data Service was changed or modified

anyOf.description: A year and month in YYYY-MM format

publisher.title: publisher
publisher.description: An entity (organization) responsible for making the Data Service available

rights.title: rights
rights.description: A list of statements concerning all rights for the Data Service that may not be addressed by license or accessRights, such as copyright statements, statements about the intellectual property rights (IPR), or information regarding access or restrictions based on privacy, security, or other policies

anyOf.description: Full text of a statement of rights

anyOf.title: Link
anyOf.description: reference iri of a statement of rights

rightsHolder.title: rights holder
rightsHolder.description: A list of Agents (organizations) holding rights on the Data Service

spatial.title: spatial/geographic coverage
spatial.description: A geographic region that is covered by the Data Service

temporal.title: temporal coverage
temporal.description: A list of temporal periods that the DataService covers

title.title: title
title.description: The title of the data service in the indicated language

category.title: category
category.description: List of categories for the Data Service

hasQualityMeasurement.title: quality measurement
hasQualityMeasurement.description: Refers to the performed quality measurements

qualifiedAttribution.title: qualified attribution
qualifiedAttribution.description: List of agents having some form of responsibility for the Data Service

wasUsedBy.title: was used by
wasUsedBy.description: List of activities that used the Data Service
